products.notes: Specs from Behringer U-PHORIA Quick Start Guide spec table (copy: https://www.adorama.com/col/productManuals/BEUMC404HD.pdf). Gain range not published. 1 MIDAS-design mic/line combo + 1 instrument input; 2x 1/4 inch TRS line out, max output 0 dBu; mic max input +2 dBu. Max 48 kHz. No loopback; no dedicated ASIO listed. Very low output level - may not drive a DSP/amp input fully for test signals.

Specs from Behringer U-PHORIA Quick Start Guide spec table (copy: https://www.adorama.com/col/productManuals/BEUMC404HD.pdf). Gain range not published. 2 MIDAS-design XLR/TRS combo inputs with pad; max input mic -4 dBu / line +20 dBu / inst -3 dBu; line out max +3 dBu. No hardware loopback (use analog loop cable on input 2 as timing reference).

Specs from Behringer U-PHORIA Quick Start Guide spec table (copy: https://www.adorama.com/col/productManuals/BEUMC404HD.pdf). Gain range not published. 2 MIDAS-design combo inputs; outputs: 2 main (1/4 inch) + playback A/B 1-4 on RCA; main/playback max +3 dBu; MIDI I/O; 2 inserts. No loopback.

Specs from Behringer U-PHORIA Quick Start Guide spec table (copy: https://www.adorama.com/col/productManuals/BEUMC404HD.pdf). Gain range not published. 4 MIDAS-design combo inputs; outputs: 2 XLR + 2 TRS main, 4 TRS + 4 RCA playback; max output +3 dBu; 4 inserts; MIDI. No loopback. 4 preamps = up to 4 measurement mics (or 3 mics + analog reference loop).

audioInterface.connection: USB 2.0, type B, USB bus power plus DC adapter
